instruction: Change the title font size to 48 pt.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully added a bullet point to the slide body text in LibreOffice Impress by clicking the text box, selecting all text (Ctrl+A), and clicking the Toggle Unordered List button in the Properties panel. Completed in 4 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can interact with LibreOffice Impress UI, select text in text boxes, use Properties panel formatting buttons, apply text formatting
metadata.task_rationale: Since the model can select text and use the Properties panel, this variation tests changing font size via the font size input in the Character panel, a slightly harder but related formatting task.
metadata.explanation: Task requires changing the title font size to 48pt. Getter reads the pptx file and extracts font sizes from all runs in the title shape (shape index 0). Metric checks if all runs match the expected 48pt size with partial credit per run.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads font sizes from the title shape (slide 0, shape 0) by iterating all paragraph runs and converting EMU to pt via run.font.size / Pt(1)
Metric correctly accesses expected parameter directly as rules dict (expected.get('expected_size')) — proper handling for type='rule'
Metric uses 0.5pt tolerance for comparison and provides partial credit per run, which is reasonable
Postconfig saves the file with Ctrl+S before getter reads it, ensuring state is persisted to disk
Single instruction requirement (change title font to 48pt) is fully covered by the evaluator
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Runs with inherited (None) font size are excluded from the check. If the title text has runs that inherit font size from the theme/master rather than having explicit sizes, those runs would be silently skipped. Consider adding a fallback to check paragraph-level or shape-level font size for runs where run.font.size is None.
